evidence.quote: But persistent inflation shortfalls, such as those associated with the ELB, carry the risk that longer-term inflation expectations become anchored below the stated inflation goal.

we discussed options for mitigating ELB risks, including "makeup" strategies in which policymakers would promise to make up for past inflation shortfalls with a sustained accommodative stance of policy intended to generate higher future inflation.
I think it highly unlikely in the next downturn, whenever it is, that 10-year U.S. Treasury yields will fall by the roughly 390 basis points that we observed between June 2007 and July 2016
One of these challenges is how best to conduct monetary policy in the new world of low equilibrium interest rates.

parsed.rationale: Largely an academic speech on falling long-term yields, its policy content centers on ELB risks, inflation shortfalls and makeup strategies that would keep rates low longer. That gives it a mild dovish lean, with no near-term policy signal.
